prompt:
You are an expert digital ASIC and FPGA Verilog design engineer.
Implement the module 'TopModule' satisfying the exact specification below.

SPECIFICATION:

I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  areset
 - input  x
 - output z

The module should implement the following Mealy finite-state machine
which is an implementation of the 2's complementer. Implement using a
one-hot encoding. Resets into state A and reset is asynchronous
active-high.

  A --x=0 (z=0)--> A
  A --x=1 (z=1)--> B
  B --x=0 (z=1)--> B
  B --x=1 (z=0)--> B

Assume all sequential logic is triggered on the positive edge of the
clock.



RULES:
1. Write clean, synthesizable, standard Verilog (IEEE 1364-2001/2005 or SystemVerilog 2012).
2. The module name MUST be 'TopModule'.
3. Output ONLY the module code enclosed in a ```verilog ... ``` code block.
4. Ensure all port names and bit-widths match the specification exactly.
raw_response:
```verilog
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  x,
    output reg z
);

    // State encoding
    localparam A = 2'b01; // State A
    localparam B = 2'b10; // State B

    reg [1:0] state; // One-hot state register

    // Asynchronous reset
    always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
        if (areset) begin
            state <= A; // Reset to state A
            z <= 0;     // Output z reset to 0
        end else begin
            case (state)
                A: begin
                    if (x) begin
                        state <= B; // Transition to state B
                        z <= 1;     // Output z = 1
                    end else begin
                        state <= A; // Stay in state A
                        z <= 0;     // Output z = 0
                    end
                end
                B: begin
                    if (x) begin
                        state <= B; // Stay in state B
                        z <= 0;     // Output z = 0
                    end else begin
                        state <= B; // Stay in state B
                        z <= 1;     // Output z = 1
                    end
                end
                default: begin
                    state <= A; // Default to state A
                    z <= 0;     // Default output
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
```
